before_statement.text: Every reachable knowledge write is one admitted batch committed by the single knowledge batch writer, which the leaf-scoped knowledge-ingest and the taskless knowledge-bootstrap command lines both drive, and the mounted MCP tool surface exposes no knowledge writer of its own; which of those two command-line entries a run can actually use is decided by how its process was loaded, because an undeclared process whose package came from a Git checkout is confined to that checkout's own disposable coordination root and undeclared execution from the primary checkout is refused, so the taskless entry is reachable from an installed package or from a declared daemon surface rather than from the checkout it was built in.

after_statement.text: Every authored knowledge write -- a record, a realization or proof entry, or a history row that a curator hands in -- goes through one of two command lines, the leaf-scoped knowledge-ingest and the taskless knowledge-bootstrap, and the mounted MCP tool surface exposes no authoring writer of its own. Each command line selects its writer by the memory tree it writes: a converted tree (one that holds knowledge/layout.json) is written as knowledge files by the curator file writer, and an unconverted tree is written as one admitted batch by the single knowledge batch writer, which refuses a converted tree and is locked once its memory repository holds converted memory. Which of the two command-line entries a run can actually use is decided by how its process was loaded, because an undeclared process whose package came from a Git checkout is confined to that checkout's own disposable coordination root and undeclared execution from the primary checkout is refused, so the taskless entry is reachable from an installed package or from a declared daemon surface rather than from the checkout it was built in.
